name: Arcane Archer
summary: An elven-style archer who weaves magic into arrows.

features.name: Arcane Archer Lore
features.short: Arcana or Nature, and Prestidigitation or Druidcraft.
features.summary: You gain proficiency in Arcana or Nature, and you learn the Prestidigitation or Druidcraft cantrip.

options.name: Prestidigitation
options.summary: Minor magical tricks.

options.name: Druidcraft
options.summary: Minor nature tricks.

features.name: Arcane Shot
features.short: Twice per short rest, add a magical effect to an arrow hit.
features.summary: You learn two Arcane Shot options and can use one when you hit with a ranged attack from a shortbow or longbow, once per turn. You have two uses per short or long rest. You learn more options at 7th, 10th, 15th and 18th level, and damage increases at 18th. Save DC = 8 + PB + INT.

options.name: Banishing Arrow
options.summary: CHA save or the target is banished to the Feywild until the end of its next turn (later +2d6 force).

options.name: Beguiling Arrow
options.summary: +2d6 psychic; WIS save or charmed by an ally of your choice.

options.name: Bursting Arrow
options.summary: Explodes: 2d6 force to everything within 10 ft. of the target.

options.name: Enfeebling Arrow
options.summary: +2d6 necrotic; CON save or the target deals half damage with weapons.

options.name: Grasping Arrow
options.summary: +2d6 poison; brambles slow the target and hurt it as it moves.

options.name: Piercing Arrow
options.summary: Pierce in a 30 ft. line; each creature makes a DEX save against 1d6 + weapon damage.

options.name: Seeking Arrow
options.summary: Ignore cover, hit a creature you've seen in the last minute; +1d6 force, reveals its location.

options.name: Shadow Arrow
options.summary: +2d6 psychic; WIS save or the target can't see beyond 5 ft.

features.name: Magic Arrow
features.summary: Whenever you fire a nonmagical arrow from a shortbow or longbow, it becomes magical for overcoming resistance.

features.name: Curving Shot
features.short: Bonus action: redirect a missed magic arrow.
features.summary: When you miss with a magic arrow, you can use a bonus action to reroll the attack against a different target within 60 ft. of the original.

features.name: Ever-Ready Shot
features.short: Regain one Arcane Shot if you have none at initiative.
features.summary: If you have no uses of Arcane Shot when you roll initiative, you regain one.
